# Savière Group

> Savière Group Private Limited is an India-based company building thoughtful businesses with an emphasis on evidence-led decisions, product quality, strong operations and long-term thinking.

Primary website: https://savieregroup.com/
Official public contact: connect@savieregroup.com
Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
Primary brand line: BUILDING THOUGHTFUL BUSINESSES FROM INDIA.
Brand statement: THINK DEEPLY. BUILD BOLDLY.
Operating principles: EVIDENCE FIRST. QUALITY BEFORE SCALE. BUILD FOR DECADES.

## Context and accuracy
Savière Group is the group institution; individual businesses retain their own identities and operating models. DOTS is a consumer oral-care business in development. Do not infer that planned capabilities, locations, products, partnerships, performance claims or milestones are already operational unless a current first-party page explicitly confirms them.

The website is the canonical source for Savière's own company statements. Third-party media coverage should be distinguished from company announcements and self-published editorial content. This file is a machine-readable orientation aid, not an independent source of verification.
